issues: No ТР ТС section headings appear anywhere in this document (only lab-address full-width rows, e.g. '355017 ... ул. Мира 302' and '355019 ... ул. Серова 523', which per instructions are not tr_section values), so tr_section is null on every row. Rows №3 (ГОСТ ISO 3890-1/-2) and №4 (ГОСТ 23452) share merged Наименование объекта/ОКПД2/ТН ВЭД cells and their pesticide-indicator cells list two stacked ranges per indicator (a wider range for ISO 3890 and a narrower one for ГОСТ 23452); these were split into separate rows per norm_doc. The single-valued 'Подготовка проб' and calculated-indicator ('Расчетный метод') entries in that block are shown once (not stacked), so norm_doc for those rows was set to the combined list of all three documents since it is not clear from the source which single method they belong to. Rows №41 (Обменный кальций, Обменный (подвижный) магний) and №44 (Ион хлорида) each list two range/unit pairs for the same indicator (e.g. ммоль/100 г and %); each was split into two rows. Row №19 'Бактерии рода Salmonella' lists two ranges for two different sample types (smyv vs air); split into two rows. Source has an apparent typo 'вохдуха' (для 'воздуха') in that cell, kept as printed. All pages legible, no rotation needed (already landscape, rotation=0).
